title: kbpack manifest (kbpack.json)
description: Manifest for an open-format .kbpack extension pack (SPEC section 3).

id.description: Reverse-DNS or short pack id, e.g. com.ex.ne-math.

kind.description: Pack kind. MVP only ships vocab packs.

paid.description: Whether the pack is a paid plugin. Uncertified/unsigned packs install with a warning; the loader is never exclusive to the store.

priority.description: Stack priority: base EN/NE is 0, extensions 10-90 (user-ordered), personal 100.

dict.description: Dictionary payload files inside the .kbpack bundle.

tokenizer.description: Optional WASM tokenizer id (word -> seq). Sandboxed on Android; no arbitrary code.

minCore.description: Minimum kbcore version required to load this pack.
